BridgeUrl.Name: Bridge URL
BridgeUrl.Hint: WebSocket URL of heroes-theme-bot, e.g. wss://bot.example.com. Only the GM connects.

BridgeToken.Name: Bridge token
BridgeToken.Hint: The token shown by /heroestheme token on Discord. Stored in this browser only.

Menu.Name: Themes
Menu.Label: Configure themes
Menu.Hint: Bridge connection, player themes and triggers. Visible to the GM only.

MyThemes.Name: My themes
MyThemes.Label: Choose my themes
MyThemes.Hint: Your mood and the music that plays when you speak.

Config.Title: Hero's Theme
Config.PlayersHint: Theme is a fallback used only when the player has not chosen their own. Players pick their themes and mood themselves; characters get theirs from the Hero's Theme entry in the sheet header.
Config.AllowUploadsHint: Changes Foundry's role permissions (Upload Files and Use File Browser) for the Player and Trusted Player roles. Without it, players can only choose sounds that are already in their playlist.

Notify.MissingBridge: Hero's Theme: set the bridge URL and token under Configure themes in the module settings.
Notify.InvalidConfig: Hero's Theme: the configuration is invalid and was not saved.
Notify.Refused: Hero's Theme: the bot refused the connection. Check the bridge token and module version.

Themes.MoodHint: Your theme changes with your mood. You can also change it from the Players list.
Themes.NoSounds: There are no sounds to choose from yet. Add music to a playlist first.
Themes.HintUser: Moods left on None use your Default theme. A character with its own themes takes priority while you control its token.
Themes.HintActor: Plays when whoever controls this character's token speaks. Moods left on None use this character's Default theme, then the speaker's own themes.
Themes.PlaylistHint: Add your own tracks to this playlist, then pick them above.
Themes.UploadDisabled: Uploading files is disabled for players. Ask the GM to enable it, or choose from the sounds already available.
Themes.NoPlaylist: You do not have a playlist yet. It is created once the GM links your Discord account.
